verdict.rationale: Spline has a published pricing page (spline.design/pricing) that lists plan features such as code and self-hosted exports, file version history and Team Library. That shows some feature-level tier differentiation is published, but the evidence shows nothing more. Missing for 10: named tiers and their prices, seat types (editor vs viewer), AI-feature gating or credit limits per plan, and independent corroboration that the pricing is clear.

support.subject: As a product manager, published plan pricing makes seat types, tiers, and AI-feature gating clear before procurement
